description: Search live New, Used, Certified Pre-Owned, and Classic/Collector car inventory across participating US franchise dealerships, 20+ specialist classic & collector showrooms (Streetside Classics, Classic Auto Mall, GR Auto Gallery, RK Motors, Vanguard Motor Sales, Volo Auto Museum, Worldwide Vintage Autos, Fleming's Ultimate Garage, DriverSource, Park Place LTD, Hagerty Classifieds), and live collector auctions (Bring a Trailer & Hagerty Marketplace). Supports natural free-text query (e.g., '427 4-speed', 'Coyote restomod', 'Slant Nose', 'numbers-matching'), classic_only, era ('pre_war', '1950s', '1960s', '1970s', '1980s', '1990s_radwood', 'modern_classic'), listing_type ('dealer_showroom' vs 'auction'), no_reserve_only, manual_only, origin ('american', 'european', 'german', 'italian', 'british', 'japanese'), build_style ('restomod', 'pro_touring', 'concours', 'survivor', 'original', 'restored', 'custom', 'driver'), numbers_matching, year_min/year_max (1900-2028), price_max (up to $10M), and zip + radius_miles (up to 3500 miles).

air_cooled_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to classic air-cooled collector vehicles (pre-1999 Porsche 356/911/912/914/930/964/993, classic Volkswagen Beetle/Bus/Karmann Ghia/Thing, Chevrolet Corvair, etc.).

american_trucks_and_suvs_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to domestic American pickup trucks and SUVs (Ford, Chevrolet, GMC, Ram, Jeep, Cadillac, Lincoln, Dodge, Buick, Rivian, Hummer).

awd_or_4wd_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to all-weather & winter-ready AWD, 4WD, and 4x4 vehicles (including 4MATIC, quattro, xDrive, Symmetrical AWD, and 4WD trucks/SUVs).

awd_or_4wd_truck_under_35k_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to 4WD / 4x4 / AWD pickup trucks with a verified dealership price between $1,000 and $35,000 (excludes timed auctions).

awd_sedan_or_coupe_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to all-wheel-drive (AWD / 4MATIC / xDrive / Quattro / Symmetrical AWD) sedans, coupes, hatchbacks, and sportbacks (excluding SUVs, trucks, and vans).

awd_suv_under_25k_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to all-weather AWD / 4WD SUVs & crossovers with a verified dealership price between $1,000 and $25,000 (excludes timed auctions).

below_msrp_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to verified-price vehicles advertised strictly below factory MSRP sticker (discounted by at least $250).

budget_luxury_under_30k_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to verified-price luxury marque vehicles (BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Porsche, Audi, Lexus, Cadillac, Lincoln, Genesis, Acura, INFINITI, Volvo, Land Rover, Jaguar, Alfa Romeo, Maserati) priced under $30,000 (excluding timed auctions).

build_style.description: Filter classic vehicles by restoration or build style ('restomod', 'pro_touring', 'concours', 'survivor', 'original', 'restored', 'custom', 'driver').

certified_only.description: If true, only return factory Certified Pre-Owned (CPO) vehicles.

chassis_code.description: Enthusiast chassis or generation code (e.g., Corvette 'C1'..'C8', Porsche '930'/'964'/'993'/'996'/'997'/'991'/'992', BMW 'E30'/'E36'/'E46'/'E39'/'E92'/'F80'/'G80', Nissan 'R32'/'R33'/'R34'/'R35'/'S30'/'Z32', Supra 'A80'/'MK4'/'A90'/'MK5', RX-7 'FD3S', S2000 'AP1'/'AP2', NSX 'NA1'/'NA2', Mustang 'Fox Body'/'S197'/'S550'/'S650', Chevy 'Tri-Five'/'Squarebody', 'Early Bronco', 'FJ40'/'FJ60'/'FJ80', Wrangler 'TJ'/'JK'/'JL').

classic_convertible_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to classic & vintage (2001 & older or classic-tagged) open-top convertibles, roadsters, cabriolets, Spyders, and Targas.

classic_european_sports_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to classic (2001 & older or classic-tagged) European sports cars, roadsters, and GTs (Porsche, Ferrari, Jaguar, MG, Triumph, Austin-Healey, Alfa Romeo, Aston Martin, Lotus, Maserati, BMW M/Coupe/Roadster, Mercedes-Benz SL/Coupe/Cabriolet, VW Karmann Ghia).

classic_muscle_or_corvette_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to classic (2001 & older or classic-tagged) American muscle cars and Corvettes (Mustang, Camaro, Corvette, Chevelle, GTO, Charger, Challenger, Firebird/Trans Am, Cuda/Barracuda, Road Runner, 442, Grand National, Cobra).

classic_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to classic, vintage, and collector vehicles (pre-2001 or specialist collector showrooms/auctions).

classic_pickup_or_4x4_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to vintage & classic (2001 & older or classic-tagged) pickup trucks and classic 4x4 SUVs (Chevy C10/K5 Blazer/3100, Ford F-100/Bronco, Toyota FJ40/FJ60 Land Cruiser, Land Rover Defender/Series, International Scout, Jeep CJ/Wagoneer, GMC Syclone/Typhoon).

classic_under_30k_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to entry-level classic & vintage enthusiast vehicles (2001 & older or classic-tagged) with a verified showroom/dealership price between $1,000 and $30,000 (excludes timed auctions).

classic_v8_manual_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to classic & vintage enthusiast vehicles (2001 & older or classic-tagged) equipped with BOTH V8 power AND a manual / stick-shift / 4-speed / 5-speed / 6-speed / Tremec transmission.

commercial_van_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to commercial cargo, passenger & fleet vans (Ford Transit/E-Transit/E-Series, Mercedes-Benz Sprinter/eSprinter/Metris, Ram ProMaster, Chevrolet Express/BrightDrop, GMC Savana, Nissan NV).

commuter_special_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to reliable late-model everyday commuter cars & SUVs (model year 2018+, verified price <= $22,000, and verified odometer <= 60,000 miles).

compact_suv_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to popular compact & subcompact crossovers (RAV4, CR-V, HR-V, Corolla Cross, CX-5, CX-50, CX-30, Forester, Crosstrek, Rogue, Kicks, Tucson, Kona, Sportage, Seltos, Equinox, Trax, Trailblazer, Terrain, Escape, Bronco Sport, Tiguan, Taos, Compass, Outlander, Envista, Encore).

compact_suv_under_25k_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to popular compact & subcompact crossovers (RAV4, CR-V, HR-V, Corolla Cross, CX-5, CX-50, CX-30, Forester, Crosstrek, Rogue, Tucson, Kona, Sportage, Seltos, Equinox, Trax, Trailblazer, Escape, Bronco Sport, Tiguan, Taos, Compass, Outlander) with a verified dealership price between $1,000 and $25,000 (excludes timed auctions).

condition.description: Filter by vehicle condition ('new', 'used', or 'certified'). Omit to search all conditions.

convertible_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to open-top Convertibles, Roadsters, Cabriolets, Spyders/Spiders, and Targas.

convertible_or_roadster_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to open-top convertibles, roadsters, cabriolets, Spyders, and Targas (modern & classic).

cpo_or_new_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to factory warranty-backed inventory (Brand-New or factory Certified Pre-Owned).

cpo_suv_under_30k_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to factory Certified Pre-Owned (CPO) SUVs and Crossovers with a verified dealership price between $1,000 and $30,000 (excludes timed auctions).

cpo_under_30k_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to factory Certified Pre-Owned (CPO) vehicles with a verified dealership price between $1,000 and $30,000 (excludes timed auctions).

dealer_id.description: Filter by specific dealer or classic showroom ID (e.g., 'dealer_rk_motors_charlotte', 'dealer_streetside_classics_tampa', 'dealer_bring_a_trailer').

diesel_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to turbo-diesel & diesel-powered trucks, vans, SUVs, and cars (Power Stroke, Duramax, Cummins, EcoDiesel, TDI, BlueTEC).

diesel_truck_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to Diesel pickup trucks (Power Stroke, Duramax, Cummins, EcoDiesel, Turbo-Diesel).

european_luxury_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to German, British, Italian & Swedish luxury and performance marques (Porsche, BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Audi, Land Rover, Jaguar, Volvo, Alfa Romeo, Maserati, Ferrari, Lamborghini, Aston Martin, Bentley, Rolls-Royce, McLaren, Lotus, Polestar, INEOS).

european_suv_under_35k_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to European luxury SUVs and Crossovers (BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Audi, Porsche, Volvo, Land Rover, Jaguar, Alfa Romeo, Maserati, etc.) with a verified dealership price between $1,000 and $35,000 (excludes timed auctions).

ev_or_hybrid_under_25k_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to EV, Hybrid, and Plug-In Hybrid dealership vehicles with a verified price between $1,000 and $25,000 (excludes timed auctions).

ev_under_35k_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to pure battery-electric vehicles (EVs) with a verified dealership price between $1,000 and $35,000 (excludes in-progress timed auctions).

exotic_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to exotic supercars & ultra-luxury halo models (Ferrari, Lamborghini, McLaren, Aston Martin, Bentley, Rolls-Royce, Bugatti, Pagani, Koenigsegg, Lotus, Ford GT, Viper, NSX, R8, AMG GT, Porsche GT3/GT2/Turbo S/Carrera GT).

family_suv_or_minivan_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to family minivans and midsize/full-size family SUVs (Odyssey, Sienna, Pacifica, Carnival, Pilot, Passport, Highlander, Grand Highlander, Sequoia, Telluride, Palisade, Sorento, Santa Fe, Tahoe, Suburban, Yukon, Traverse, Enclave, Acadia, Expedition, Explorer, Atlas, Ascent, CX-90, Pathfinder, Armada, MDX, TX, GX, Q7, GLE, GLS, X5, X7, XC90, Wagoneer, Durango, EV9, R1S, Model X).

full_size_truck_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to half-ton and heavy-duty full-size pickup trucks (Ford F-150/Lightning/F-250/F-350/Super Duty, Chevrolet Silverado 1500/2500HD/3500HD/Silverado EV, GMC Sierra 1500/2500HD/3500HD/Hummer EV Pickup, Ram 1500/2500/3500, Toyota Tundra, Nissan Titan, Tesla Cybertruck, Rivian R1T).

german_engineering_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to German performance, luxury & engineering marques (Porsche, BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Audi, Volkswagen, Alpina, Maybach, RUF, Opel).

golden_era_muscle_1964_1972_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to authentic 1964-1972 Golden-Era American Muscle Cars and Corvettes (Mustang, Camaro, Chevelle, GTO, Charger, Challenger, Cuda/Barracuda, Road Runner, Super Bee, Corvette, Firebird/Trans Am, 442, Torino, Cougar, Cobra, Javelin, AMX).

heavy_duty_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to heavy-duty 3/4-ton and 1-ton towing & work trucks (Ford F-250/F-350/F-450 Super Duty, Chevrolet Silverado 2500HD/3500HD, GMC Sierra 2500HD/3500HD, Ram 2500/3500).

hybrid_or_ev_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to electrified vehicles across all battery-electric (EV), Hybrid, and Plug-In Hybrid (PHEV) powertrains.

hybrid_under_30k_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to gas-electric Hybrid & Plug-In Hybrid dealership vehicles (excludes pure battery-EVs and timed auctions) with a verified price between $1,000 and $30,000.

induction_type.description: Filter by engine aspiration / forced induction ('turbo', 'twin_turbo', 'supercharged', or 'naturally_aspirated').

japanese_reliability_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to Japanese reliability leader marques (Toyota, Lexus, Honda, Acura, Mazda, Subaru).

japanese_suv_under_25k_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to Japanese-brand SUVs and Crossovers (Toyota, Lexus, Honda, Acura, Mazda, Subaru) with a verified dealership price between $1,000 and $25,000 (excludes timed auctions).

jdm_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to JDM & Japanese enthusiast icons and right-hand-drive imports (Skyline GT-R, Supra, NSX, RX-7, S2000, Datsun 240Z/280Z, Silvia, Type R, WRX STI, Lancer Evo, Land Cruiser FJ40/FJ60/FJ80, Kei trucks/cars, RHD imports).

korean_value_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to Korean value, safety & 10-year-powertrain-warranty marques (Hyundai, Kia, Genesis).

limit.description: Max vehicles to return per page (1-100, default: 20).

listing_type.description: Filter by 'dealer_showroom' (fixed/negotiable dealership & classic showroom cars eligible for Shielded Deal-Desk OTD & shipping quotes) or 'auction' (live timed enthusiast auctions on Bring a Trailer and Hagerty Marketplace).

low_mileage_collector_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to investment-grade, low-mileage time-capsule collector & enthusiast cars (model year 2012 or older with verified odometer <= 25,000 miles).

low_miles_under_30k_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to gently-driven pre-owned and Certified Pre-Owned dealership vehicles with verified price and verified odometer <= 30,000 miles (excluding timed auctions).

luxury_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to luxury & ultra-luxury marques (Porsche, BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Audi, Lexus, Cadillac, Lincoln, Genesis, Acura, INFINITI, Volvo, Land Rover, Jaguar, Maserati, Aston Martin, Bentley, Rolls-Royce, Ferrari, Lamborghini, McLaren, Lucid, Rivian).

luxury_suv_under_35k_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to Luxury SUVs and Crossovers (Lexus, BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Audi, Porsche, Cadillac, Lincoln, Genesis, Acura, Volvo, Land Rover, etc.) with a verified dealership price between $1,000 and $35,000 (excludes timed auctions).

make.description: Vehicle make or colloquial enthusiast alias (e.g., 'Chevrolet' or 'Chevy', 'Volkswagen' or 'VW', 'Mercedes-Benz' or 'Mercedes', 'Mopar', 'Ford', 'Porsche', 'BMW', 'Toyota').

manual_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to manual-transmission / stick-shift vehicles (4-speed, 5-speed, 6-speed, Tremec, etc.).

midsize_or_compact_truck_under_35k_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to midsize and compact pickup trucks (Tacoma, Ranger, Maverick, Colorado, Canyon, Gladiator, Frontier, Ridgeline, Santa Cruz) with a verified dealership price between $1,000 and $35,000 (excludes timed auctions).

midsize_truck_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to midsize & compact pickup trucks (Toyota Tacoma, Ford Ranger & Maverick, Chevrolet Colorado, GMC Canyon, Jeep Gladiator, Nissan Frontier, Honda Ridgeline, Hyundai Santa Cruz).

mileage_min.description: Minimum odometer mileage in miles (e.g., 0 or 5000).

mpg_min.description: Minimum EPA fuel economy rating in MPG (e.g., 30, 35, 40, or 50 for high-efficiency commuters and hybrids).

muscle_car_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to classic & modern American muscle and pony cars (Mustang, Camaro, Challenger, Charger, Corvette, GTO, Chevelle, Firebird/Trans Am, Barracuda/'Cuda, Road Runner, 442, Grand National, Cobra, Viper).

new_under_30k_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to brand-new ('condition: new') dealership vehicles with full factory warranty and a verified price between $1,000 and $30,000.

no_reserve_only.description: If true, filter live collector auctions to No-Reserve listings only.

numbers_matching.description: If true, filter to classic vehicles advertising numbers-matching engine/drivetrain.

off_road_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to factory off-road & overlanding packages/models (Ford Raptor/Bronco Badlands/Wildtrak/Sasquatch/Tremor, Toyota TRD Pro/TRD Off-Road/Trailhunter/Land Cruiser, Jeep Wrangler Rubicon/Mojave, Ram TRX/Rebel/Power Wagon, Chevy ZR2/Z71/Trail Boss, GMC AT4/AT4X, Subaru Wilderness, Lexus Overtrail, Land Rover Defender, Mercedes G-Class).

one_owner_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to CARFAX One-Owner vehicles.

one_owner_suv_under_30k_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to CARFAX One-Owner SUVs and Crossovers with a verified dealership price between $1,000 and $30,000 (excludes timed auctions).

one_owner_under_25k_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to CARFAX One-Owner dealership vehicles with verified price between $1,000 and $25,000 (excluding timed auctions).

origin.description: Filter by marque country/region of origin ('american', 'european', 'german', 'italian', 'british', 'japanese', 'korean', 'swedish').

pickup_truck_under_30k_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to pickup trucks (F-150, Silverado, Sierra, Ram, Tacoma, Tundra, Colorado, Ranger, Maverick, Frontier, Gladiator, Ridgeline, or pickup truck body styles) with a verified dealership price between $1,000 and $30,000 (excludes timed auctions).

plug_in_hybrid_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to Plug-In Hybrid Electric Vehicles (PHEVs, 4xe, Prime, Recharge, E-Hybrid) offering electric daily commuting plus gas road-trip range.

porsche_enthusiast_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to enthusiast & collector Porsche sports cars (911/930/964/993/996/997/991/992, 356, 718 Boxster/Cayman, GT2/GT3/GT4, Spyder, 944/928/968, Taycan, Carrera GT, 918).

powertrain_type.description: Filter by powertrain architecture ('ev' for pure battery-electric, 'hybrid', 'plug_in_hybrid' for PHEV/4xe/Prime, 'diesel', or 'gasoline').

pre_1975_classic_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to 1975 & older chrome-bumper / smog-exempt golden-era classic & antique vehicles.

price_max.description: Maximum advertised price (or current bid on auctions) in USD (up to 10000000).

price_min.description: Minimum advertised price (or current bid on auctions) in USD (e.g., 15000 or 50000).

query.description: Optional free-text search query (e.g., 'new SUV', '1968 Corvette 427', 'classic Mustang fastback', 'air-cooled 911', 'Coyote restomod').

radius_miles.description: Search radius in miles from the ZIP centroid (default: 25, max: 3500 for coast-to-coast classic enclosed shipping).

radwood_80s_90s_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to 1980-1999 RADwood-era modern classics and retro enthusiast vehicles.

region.description: Regional market filter (e.g., 'South Florida', 'Classic & Collector Showrooms', 'Tampa Bay', 'Atlanta', 'Texas', 'Carolinas').

sedan_or_hatchback_under_18k_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to sedans, hatchbacks, liftbacks, sportbacks, and coupes with a verified dealership price between $1,000 and $18,000 (excludes timed auctions, SUVs, trucks, and vans).

seventies_classic_1970_1979_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to 1970-1979 malaise-era & late-muscle classics, vintage 4x4s, and European roadsters.

sort_by.description: Sort order for results (default: 'price'; use 'biggest_discount' for largest dollar savings below MSRP, 'new_biggest_savings' for brand-new vehicles with largest dollar discount off MSRP first, 'cpo_lowest_price' for factory Certified Pre-Owned vehicles at lowest verified price first, 'one_owner_lowest_price' for CARFAX One-Owner vehicles at lowest verified price first, 'used_lowest_miles' for pre-owned/CPO vehicles with lowest positive odometer mileage first, 'hybrid_lowest_price' for gas-electric Hybrid & PHEV vehicles at lowest verified price first, 'awd_lowest_price' for all-wheel-drive / 4WD vehicles at lowest verified price first, 'classic_lowest_price' for classic & collector vehicles at lowest verified price first, 'truck_lowest_price' for pickup trucks at lowest verified price first, 'suv_lowest_price' for SUVs & Crossovers at lowest verified price first, 'ev_lowest_price' for pure battery-electric vehicles at lowest verified price first, 'convertible_lowest_price' for open-top convertibles, roadsters, and Targas at lowest verified price first, 'sedan_lowest_price' for sedans, coupes, and hatchbacks at lowest verified price first, 'msrp_discount_pct' for largest percentage discount off MSRP, 'highest_msrp' for flagship/highest-sticker builds first, 'highest_mpg' for best fuel economy, 'best_mpg_per_dollar' for highest MPG per dollar of verified price, 'lowest_miles_per_year' for lightly driven garage-queen cars, 'newest_arrival' for freshly listed arrivals, 'year_desc_mileage_asc' for newest model year with lowest odometer first, 'newest_lowest_price' for newest model year at lowest verified price first, 'oldest' for pre-war/vintage first, or 'ending_soon' for live auctions).

state.description: US state filter — accepts 2-letter code or full state name (e.g., 'FL', 'TX', 'PA', 'CO', 'WA', 'NY', 'Pennsylvania').

suv_or_crossover_under_20k_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to SUVs and Crossovers with a verified dealership price between $1,000 and $20,000 (excludes timed auctions).

third_row_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to 3-row family SUVs and minivans (Tahoe, Suburban, Yukon, Escalade, Expedition, Explorer, Telluride, Palisade, Highlander, Grand Highlander, Sequoia, Sienna, Pilot, Odyssey, MDX, TX, GX, LX, Q7, GLS, X7, XC90, Atlas, Ascent, Pathfinder, Armada, QX60, QX80, CX-90, Traverse, Enclave, Acadia, Aviator, Navigator, Wagoneer, Durango, Pacifica, Carnival, EV9, R1S).

three_row_luxury_suv_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to flagship 3-row luxury SUVs (Cadillac Escalade/XT6/VISTIQ, Lincoln Navigator/Aviator, BMW X7, Mercedes-Benz GLS/EQS SUV/EQB, Audi Q7, Volvo XC90/EX90, Lexus TX/GX/LX, Acura MDX, INFINITI QX80/QX60, Land Rover Defender 130/Discovery, Genesis GV80, Rivian R1S, Tesla Model X, Jeep Grand Wagoneer).

three_row_under_35k_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to 3-row family SUVs and minivans (Telluride, Palisade, Highlander, Pilot, Sienna, Odyssey, Tahoe, Suburban, Explorer, Atlas, Ascent, Traverse, MDX, CX-9/CX-90, Pacifica, Carnival) with a verified dealership price between $1,000 and $35,000 (excludes timed auctions).

tow_ready_suv_or_truck_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to full-size & heavy-towing SUVs and pickup trucks (F-150/Super Duty, Expedition, Silverado, Tahoe, Suburban, Sierra, Yukon, Ram 1500/2500/3500, Durango, Wagoneer, Tundra, Sequoia, Land Cruiser, Titan, Armada, Escalade, Navigator, GX, LX, Defender, Range Rover, QX80, Rivian R1T/R1S, Cybertruck).

track_trim_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to factory motorsport & performance-division trims (BMW M2/M3/M4/M5/M8, Mercedes-AMG 63/45/GT, Audi RS/R8, Porsche GT3/GT2/GT4/Turbo S/GTS, Corvette Z06/ZR1/E-Ray, Camaro ZL1/1LE, Cadillac V-Series Blackwing, Mustang Shelby GT350/GT500/Dark Horse/Boss 302/Mach 1, Dodge Hellcat/Viper, Civic Type R, GR Corolla/GR Supra, Nissan GT-R/NISMO, WRX STI).

v8_only.description: If true, filter exclusively to V8-powered vehicles (including Small Block, Big Block, Hemi, Coyote, LS, and classic cubic-inch V8s).

year_min.description: Minimum model year from 1900 to 2028 (e.g., 1965 or 2020).

zip.description: 5-digit US ZIP code for geo-radius search (e.g., '33140' for Miami Beach, '78701' for Austin).
